intro.text: A skaa apprentice in Clubs's workshop in Luthadel, who also keeps watch for the thieving crews Clubs protects.

items.text: Apprenticed to Clubs, he helped make furniture and also worked with him guarding thieving crews.

Was still with Clubs when Kelsier ran his rebellion from the shop. When Kelsier had Lord Renoux leave his Fellise mansion and pretend to head back to the Farmost Dominance, Spook went too, and Tase became the crew's main lookout.
On watch after Renoux's household was captured, he saw crowds gathering in the fountain square and heard the obligators planned more executions, and ran in to tell Kelsier, Vin and the crew.
